summary: Quanta Services filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a proposed offering of senior unsecured notes across three tranches due at unspecified dates. The notes rank equally with existing senior unsecured debt, are structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities, and carry a 101% change-of-control repurchase offer. Interest is semi-annual. Joint book-runners are BofA Securities, Wells Fargo, J.P. Morgan, PNC and Truist. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation; no equity or strategic event is involved.
